[7PM] #Badagry #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic is currently slow from Agbara Custom Check Point to Agbara Estate gate due to congestion.
Movement is free from Agbara Estate to Morogbo Junction and beyond to Okoafo and Badagry roundabout. 
The stretch from Badagry roundabout to Seme Gbaji road is also moving smoothly in both directions. 
Traffic is flowing as expected in Badagry town and Ajara. 
The return journey from Badagry roundabout to Agbara via Ijanikin is smooth. 
Traffic officers are actively managing the situation, with no major impediments reported.

[7:32PM] #Alausa_Ikeja #TrafficUpdate 

Movement on Obafemi Awolowo Way is smooth from Barrack to Olowu Junction, but becomes slow from Olowu to Ikeja Underbridge due to spillover traffic from Ikeja Along Overpass. 
The return journey has slight delays at Allen intersection and Radio junction. 
Lateef Jakande Road is congested from Mobil to Omole Roundabout, and AY Junction to Wemco Junction is also busy. However, Aromire to Hacco, Mobolaji Johnson Avenue, and Dr. Nurudeen Olowopopo Avenue are moving well in both directions. 
Traffic officers are on ground managing the traffic situation.

[7:36PM] #Ikorodu #TrafficUpdate 

Benson inw Ikorodu Interchange is slightly busy due to commercial activities.
However, movement from Ikorodu Interchange to Oba Ayangburen Road and Owolowo to Ojubode is smooth. 
There's slight congestion at Ojubode to Ladega due to rider activities. 
Traffic flows well from Ladega to Ita-Ota, and Awolowo Road to Itamaga is clear. 
The stretch from Sabo to Ilepo Oba, LASTMA Yard, and Jubilee is moving well, but slow near First Gate due to pedestrian activity. Movement to Odogunyan is good, though slow at the approach.
